thesis: PRE-MARKET (07:30 ET) read AHEAD OF the Friday 2026-08-14 open, with the Thursday 2026-08-13 close the LAST COMPLETED daily bar — so persistence counts by completed bars and the 8/13 close is a fresh completed bar, not an intraday run. STRUCTURE FIRST: the multi-month bull is intact and 8/13 CLOSED at a fresh high. SPY closed 777.88 on 8/13 at a fresh 52-week high (pctFrom52wHigh 0), +3.99% over its 50-day (~748.0) and +10.77% over its 200-day (~702.2) on a deterministic 20>50>200 bull-stack, mom126/252 +13.01%/+22.38%; swing-structure-lab reads Bull-stacked (20>50>200, Double bottom pattern-qualified, its own pattern regime not identified), and QQQ 732.07, SPMO 152.72 and XLK 190.77 all hold their 50-days. WHAT CHANGED, AND IT IS STRUCTURAL: the breadth confirmation the beta add had been waiting on printed on the completed 8/13 bar — market-heatmap-lab reads 65.06% of 134 constituents positive against the 60% broad-market threshold (broad, margin +5.06), re-reclaiming 60% after two completed bars below it (56.47% on 8/11, 49.85% on 8/12). That is ONE completed bar back above the line, so the beta add moves from stood-down to a FIRST measured tranche, but three distinct completed bars above 60% are not yet in hand, so the remaining tranches stay gated. The last completed session closed constructively-but-unremarkable: intraday-tape-lab reads the 8/13 session a Mixed / developing auction under Algo-controlled control (VWAP 777.22, gap +0.3%, 79 bars), resolving without a distribution close; no 8/14 intraday tape has printed yet in this pre-market view. The dealer cushion is intact into the open: options-structure-lab and gamma-trading-lab (asOf 2026-08-13T16:00:00Z, dealer spot 778.45) read SPY in POSITIVE dealer gamma with the flip DOWN at 772.51 and the spot well above it, signed net GEX +13.18B, walls put 777 / call 780, playbook pin-to-maxpain / conviction patient, hold same-session-fade, atmIV 11.27% (below the calm headline VIX 14.53) with a front expected move of ±3.25 (~±0.42%, a band near ~775.2-781.7 off the 778.45 spot). Flow stays call-led: options-flow-feed-lab is call-heavy leaning bullish (callFraction 0.7099, call premium $2.75B against $1.12B of put premium across 12 tickers), its most unusual print SPY 777 CALLS at $70.5M on 90.3x open interest (0DTE), then NVDA 225C and TSLA 335C (1DTE). VIX 14.53 is a still-calm level and volatility-sizing-lab holds a NORMAL regime (SPY conditional vol 13.24%, throttle x1.13). The rotation read stays risk-on: sector-research-lab reads Rotate toward XLK as XLE weakens, and on the deterministic RRG XLK is the relative-strength LEADER (Leading, rsMom 102.08, rotating in, +21.47% over its 200-day) with XLC/XLY and MAGS improving from below (rotating in) and XLE/XLF/XLV weakening (out) while XLP/XLI/XLB/XLRE/XLU lag. etf-momentum-lab ranks VGT first (31.7%, 13 scored); global-rotation-lab keeps EWS Singapore first (85.2, strong uptrend) with EWC Canada and EWT Taiwan next; real-assets-lab keeps copper CPER the outright lead (50.2) with BTC 35.4 recovering, GLD 33.4 and SLV 10.2 below (an industrial-metals tilt, no dominant precious-metal haven; GLD 398.96 is bear-stacked, -3.21% under its 200-day). bond-regime-lab cannot make the credit or duration call this run — an independent credit-spread reading is not available in this view yet — but its high-yield-versus-investment-grade price ratio reads strengthening through 8/13 on both aligned pairs, a mild risk-on credit tell. company-fundamentals-lab (MSFT) is incomplete with no direction available in this view (statement 2026-03-31, stale and pre-print); ai-capex-strategy-lab returns only a dated 2026-06-30 scenario-assumptions estimate (not measured returns); technical-analysis-decision-lab published only its data foundation and its owner five-gate model does not feed the brief yet; fx-regime-relative-value-lab withheld every currency family for lack of an approved source, so it is not applicable this window; and msft-july-print-model, smart-money-flow-lab, strategy-self-improvement-lab, strategy-validation-lab, trend-dynamics-cycle-lab, waterfront-polo-lab, palm-springs-rental-market-lab and ocean-shores-rental-market-lab made no call this cycle. PLAN into the 8/14 open, structure-first: HOLD the structural SPY/SPMO core — the 20>50>200 bull-stack is intact, SPY closed at a fresh 52-week high and SPMO holds above its 50-day with mom21 positive. BEGIN re-staging the measured index / broad-momentum beta add with a FIRST tranche now that completed-bar breadth re-reclaimed 60% (65.06%), sized on the x1.13 throttle; hold the remaining tranches until a SECOND completed close holds breadth above 60% (three-bar persistence) while SPMO holds above ~150.6 and SPY holds above the 772.51 flip. ROTATE toward XLK (still the relative-strength leader), funded from weakening energy/financials/health (XLE/XLF/XLV), keeping the lagging XLP/XLI/XLB/XLRE/XLU OUT. HOLD MSFT (496.88, maStack still tangled, mom252 -5.36 still negative) and do NOT chase the extended gap. On the hedge: dealers hold a positive-gamma pin above the flip, atmIV stays below the headline and the last completed session closed Mixed/developing rather than distributing, so carry only a LIGHT residual tail into the open while three-bar breadth persistence is unproven and the official July NFP figure and 7/29 Fed path stay unverified, and retire it on a close that clears the 780 call wall with VIX under ~14.5. Persistence by distinct COMPLETED daily bars: breadth held above 60% on 8/7 (61.77%) and 8/10 (60.25%), broke on 8/11 (56.47%) and 8/12 (49.85%), and re-reclaimed on the completed 8/13 close (65.06%) — one completed bar back above the line, so three-bar persistence is not yet re-established. Open risk: the 8/14 calendar has no scheduled high-importance release, the next scheduled item is the BLS preliminary benchmark revision 8/28, and the official July NFP figure and 7/29 Fed statement/path remain re-pull items.
